verses.original: וַיְהִ֥י דְבַר־ יְהוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥י לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî ḏə·ḇar- Yah·weh ’ê·lay lê·mōr
verses.literal: Then the word of the LORD came to me saying
verses.literalPt: Veio a mim a palavra de Jeová, dizendo:

verses.original: בֶּן־ אָדָ֕ם הִנָּבֵ֛א אֶל־ נְבִיאֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל הַנִּבָּאִ֑ים וְאָֽמַרְתָּ֙ לִנְבִיאֵ֣י מִלִּבָּ֔ם שִׁמְע֖וּ דְּבַר־ יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ben- ’ā·ḏām hin·nā·ḇê ’el- nə·ḇî·’ê yiś·rā·’êl han·nib·bā·’îm wə·’ā·mar·tā lin·ḇî·’ê mil·lib·bām šim·‘ū də·ḇar- Yah·weh
verses.literal: Son of man prophesy against the prophets of Israel who are now prophesying Tell those who prophesy out of their own imagination Hear the word of the LORD
verses.literalPt: Filho do homem, profetiza contra os profetas de Israel que profetizam do seu coração: Ouvi a palavra de Jeová.

verses.original: כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֔ה ה֖וֹי עַל־ הַנְּבִיאִ֣ים הַנְּבָלִ֑ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר הֹלְכִ֛ים אַחַ֥ר רוּחָ֖ם וּלְבִלְתִּ֥י רָאֽוּ׃
verses.transliteration: kōh ’ā·mar ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh hō·w ‘al- han·nə·ḇî·’îm han·nə·ḇā·lîm ’ă·šer hō·lə·ḵîm ’a·ḥar rū·ḥām ū·lə·ḇil·tî rā·’ū
verses.literal: This is what the Lord GOD says Woe to the foolish prophets who follow . . . their own spirit yet have seen nothing
verses.literalPt: Assim diz o Senhor Jeová: Ai dos profetas insensatos, que seguem o seu próprio espírito e não viram nada!

verses.original: כְּשֻׁעָלִ֖ים בָּחֳרָב֑וֹת נְבִיאֶ֥יךָ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל הָיֽוּ׃
verses.transliteration: kə·šu·‘ā·lîm bā·ḥo·rā·ḇō·wṯ nə·ḇî·’e·ḵā yiś·rā·’êl hā·yū
verses.literal: Your prophets O Israel are like foxes among the ruins
verses.literalPt: Os teus profetas, ó Israel, têm sido como raposas nos lugares desertos.

verses.original: לֹ֤א עֲלִיתֶם֙ בַּפְּרָצ֔וֹת וַתִּגְדְּר֥וּ גָדֵ֖ר עַל־ בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל לַעֲמֹ֥ד בַּמִּלְחָמָ֖ה בְּי֥וֹם יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: lō ‘ă·lî·ṯem bap·pə·rā·ṣō·wṯ wat·tiḡ·də·rū ḡā·ḏêr ‘al- bêṯ yiś·rā·’êl la·‘ă·mōḏ bam·mil·ḥā·māh bə·yō·wm Yah·weh
verses.literal: You did not go up to the gaps or restore the wall around the house of Israel so that it would stand in the battle on the Day of the LORD
verses.literalPt: Não subistes às brechas, nem fizestes uma cerca em defesa da casa de Israel, para estardes firmes na batalha no dia de Jeová.

verses.original: חָ֤זוּ שָׁוְא֙ וְקֶ֣סֶם כָּזָ֔ב הָאֹֽמְרִים֙ נְאֻם־ יְהוָ֔ה וַֽיהוָ֖ה לֹ֣א שְׁלָחָ֑ם וְיִֽחֲל֖וּ לְקַיֵּ֥ם דָּבָֽר׃
verses.transliteration: ḥā·zū šāw wə·qe·sem kā·zāḇ hā·’ō·mə·rîm nə·’um- Yah·weh Yah·weh lō šə·lā·ḥām wə·yi·ḥă·lū lə·qay·yêm dā·ḇār
verses.literal: They see false visions and speak lying divinations They claim Thus declares the LORD when the LORD did not send them yet they wait for the fulfillment of their message
verses.literalPt: Viram vaidade e adivinhação mentirosa os que dizem: Jeová diz, quando Jeová os não enviou. Fizeram que os homens esperassem fosse cumprida a palavra.

verses.original: הֲל֤וֹא מַֽחֲזֵה־ שָׁוְא֙ חֲזִיתֶ֔ם וּמִקְסַ֥ם כָּזָ֖ב אֲמַרְתֶּ֑ם וְאֹֽמְרִים֙ נְאֻם־ יְהוָ֔ה וַאֲנִ֖י לֹ֥א דִבַּֽרְתִּי׃ס
verses.transliteration: hă·lō·w ma·ḥă·zêh- šāw ḥă·zî·ṯem ū·miq·sam kā·zāḇ ’ă·mar·tem wə·’ō·mə·rîm nə·’um- Yah·weh wa·’ă·nî lō ḏib·bar·tî
verses.literal: Haven’t you seen a false vision and spoken a lying divination when you proclaim Thus declares the LORD even though I have not spoken
verses.literalPt: Acaso, não tivestes visão de vaidade e não falastes adivinhação mentirosa, porquanto dizeis: Jeová diz, sendo que eu não falei?

verses.original: לָכֵ֗ן כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֔ה יַ֚עַן דַּבֶּרְכֶ֣ם שָׁ֔וְא וַחֲזִיתֶ֖ם כָּזָ֑ב לָכֵן֙ הִנְנִ֣י אֲלֵיכֶ֔ם נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהוִֽה׃
verses.transliteration: lā·ḵên kōh ’ā·mar ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh ya·‘an dab·ber·ḵem šāw wa·ḥă·zî·ṯem kā·zāḇ lā·ḵên hin·nî ’ă·lê·ḵem nə·’um ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh
verses.literal: Therefore this is what the Lord GOD says Because you have uttered vain words and seen false visions . . . . . . I am against you declares the Lord GOD
verses.literalPt: Portanto, assim diz o Senhor Jeová: Porque tendes falado vaidade e visto mentiras, por isso, eis que eu sou contra vós, diz o Senhor Jeová.

verses.original: וְהָיְתָ֣ה יָדִ֗י אֶֽל־ הַנְּבִיאִ֞ים הַחֹזִ֣ים שָׁוְא֮ וְהַקֹּסְמִ֣ים כָּזָב֒ בְּס֧וֹד עַמִּ֣י לֹֽא־ יִהְי֗וּ וּבִכְתָ֤ב בֵּֽית־ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ לֹ֣א יִכָּתֵ֔בוּ וְאֶל־ אַדְמַ֥ת יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לֹ֣א יָבֹ֑אוּ וִידַעְתֶּ֕ם כִּ֥י אֲנִ֖י אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהוִֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yə·ṯāh yā·ḏî ’el- han·nə·ḇî·’îm ha·ḥō·zîm šāw wə·haq·qō·sə·mîm kā·zāḇ bə·sō·wḏ ‘am·mî lō- yih·yū ū·ḇiḵ·ṯāḇ bêṯ- yiś·rā·’êl lō yik·kā·ṯê·ḇū wə·’el- ’aḏ·maṯ yiś·rā·’êl lō yā·ḇō·’ū wî·ḏa‘·tem kî ’ă·nî ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh
verses.literal: My hand will be against the prophets who see false visions and speak lying divinations They will not belong to the council of My people or be recorded in the register of the house of Israel nor will they enter . . . the land of Israel . . . Then you will know that I am the Lord GOD
verses.literalPt: A minha mão será contra os profetas que veem vaidade e que adivinham mentiras; não estarão no concílio do meu povo, nem serão escritos nos registros da casa de Israel, nem entrarão na terra de Israel. Sabereis que eu sou o Senhor Jeová.

verses.original: יַ֣עַן וּבְיַ֜עַן הִטְע֧וּ אֶת־ עַמִּ֛י לֵאמֹ֥ר שָׁל֖וֹם וְאֵ֣ין שָׁל֑וֹם וְהוּא֙ בֹּ֣נֶה חַ֔יִץ וְהִנָּ֛ם טָחִ֥ים אֹת֖וֹ תָּפֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: ya·‘an ū·ḇə·ya·‘an hiṭ·‘ū ’eṯ- ‘am·mî lê·mōr šā·lō·wm wə·’ên šā·lō·wm wə·hū bō·neh ḥa·yiṣ wə·hin·nām ṭā·ḥîm ’ō·ṯōw tā·p̄êl
verses.literal: Because . . . they have led My people astray saying Peace when there is no peace . . . and whitewashing - any flimsy wall that is built
verses.literalPt: Porquanto, sim, porquanto seduziram o meu povo, dizendo: Paz, e não há paz, e quando se edifica uma parede, eis que eles a rebocam de argamassa magra,

verses.original: אֱמֹ֛ר אֶל־ טָחֵ֥י תָפֵ֖ל וְיִפֹּ֑ל הָיָ֣ה׀ גֶּ֣שֶׁם שׁוֹטֵ֗ף וְאַתֵּ֜נָה אַבְנֵ֤י אֶלְגָּבִישׁ֙ תִּפֹּ֔לְנָה וְר֥וּחַ סְעָר֖וֹת תְּבַקֵּֽעַ׃
verses.transliteration: ’ĕ·mōr ’el- ṭā·ḥê ṯā·p̄êl wə·yip·pōl hā·yāh ge·šem šō·w·ṭêp̄ wə·’at·tê·nāh ’aḇ·nê ’el·gā·ḇîš tip·pō·lə·nāh wə·rū·aḥ sə·‘ā·rō·wṯ tə·ḇaq·qê·a‘
verses.literal: tell . . . those whitewashing the wall . . . that it will fall Rain will come in torrents . . . I will send hailstones . . . plunging down and a windstorm . . . will burst forth
verses.literalPt: dize aos que a rebocam de argamassa magra que cairá. Haverá uma chuva de inundação; vós, ó grandes pedras de saraiva, caireis, e um vento tempestuoso a fenderá.

verses.original: וְהִנֵּ֖ה נָפַ֣ל הַקִּ֑יר הֲלוֹא֙ יֵאָמֵ֣ר אֲלֵיכֶ֔ם אַיֵּ֥ה הַטִּ֖יחַ אֲשֶׁ֥ר טַחְתֶּֽם׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·hin·nêh nā·p̄al haq·qîr hă·lō·w yê·’ā·mêr ’ă·lê·ḵem ’ay·yêh haṭ·ṭî·aḥ ’ă·šer ṭaḥ·tem
verses.literal: Surely when the wall has fallen you will not be asked . . . Where is the whitewash with which you covered it
verses.literalPt: Eis que quando tiver caído a parede, não se vos dirá: Onde está o reboco com que a rebocastes?

verses.original: לָכֵ֗ן כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֔ה וּבִקַּעְתִּ֥י רֽוּחַ־ סְעָר֖וֹת בַּֽחֲמָתִ֑י וְגֶ֤שֶׁם שֹׁטֵף֙ בְּאַפִּ֣י יִֽהְיֶ֔ה וְאַבְנֵ֥י אֶלְגָּבִ֖ישׁ בְּחֵמָ֥ה לְכָלָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: lā·ḵên kōh ’ā·mar ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh ū·ḇiq·qa‘·tî rū·aḥ- sə·‘ā·rō·wṯ ba·ḥă·mā·ṯî wə·ḡe·šem šō·ṭêp̄ bə·’ap·pî yih·yeh wə·’aḇ·nê ’el·gā·ḇîš bə·ḥê·māh lə·ḵā·lāh
verses.literal: Therefore this is what the Lord GOD says In My wrath I will release a windstorm . . . and in My anger torrents of rain and hail will fall . . . with destructive fury
verses.literalPt: Portanto, assim diz o Senhor Jeová: Fendê-la-ei no meu furor com um vento impetuoso; e, na minha ira, haverá uma chuva de inundação e grandes pedras de saraiva com furor, para a consumir.

verses.original: וְהָ֨רַסְתִּ֜י אֶת־ הַקִּ֨יר אֲשֶׁר־ טַחְתֶּ֥ם תָּפֵ֛ל וְהִגַּעְתִּ֥יהוּ אֶל־ הָאָ֖רֶץ וְנִגְלָ֣ה יְסֹד֑וֹ וְנָֽפְלָה֙ וּכְלִיתֶ֣ם בְּתוֹכָ֔הּ וִֽידַעְתֶּ֖ם כִּֽי־ אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·ras·tî ’eṯ- haq·qîr ’ă·šer- ṭaḥ·tem tā·p̄êl wə·hig·ga‘·tî·hū ’el- hā·’ā·reṣ wə·niḡ·lāh yə·sō·ḏōw wə·nā·p̄ə·lāh ū·ḵə·lî·ṯem bə·ṯō·w·ḵāh wî·ḏa‘·tem kî- ’ă·nî Yah·weh
verses.literal: I will tear down the wall you whitewashed . . . and level it to the ground so that its foundation is exposed The city will fall and you will be destroyed within it Then you will know that I am the LORD
verses.literalPt: Assim, demolirei a parede que rebocastes de argamassa magra e darei com ela por terra, de sorte que seja descoberto o seu fundamento. Ela cairá, e vós sereis consumidos no meio dela; e sabereis que eu sou Jeová.

verses.original: וְכִלֵּיתִ֤י אֶת־ חֲמָתִי֙ בַּקִּ֔יר וּבַטָּחִ֥ים אֹת֖וֹ תָּפֵ֑ל וְאֹמַ֤ר לָכֶם֙ אֵ֣ין הַקִּ֔יר וְאֵ֖ין הַטָּחִ֥ים אֹתֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵil·lê·ṯî ’eṯ- ḥă·mā·ṯî baq·qîr ū·ḇaṭ·ṭā·ḥîm ’ō·ṯōw tā·p̄êl wə·’ō·mar lā·ḵem ’ên haq·qîr wə·’ên haṭ·ṭā·ḥîm ’ō·ṯōw
verses.literal: And after I have vented My wrath against the wall and against those who whitewashed it - I will say to you The wall is gone and so are those who whitewashed it
verses.literalPt: Assim, cumprirei o meu furor contra a parede e contra os que a rebocaram de argamassa magra e vos direi: Já não há parede, nem existem os que a rebocaram,

verses.original: נְבִיאֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל הַֽנִבְּאִים֙ אֶל־ יְר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם וְהַחֹזִ֥ים לָ֖הּ חֲז֣וֹן שָׁלֹ֑ם וְאֵ֣ין שָׁלֹ֔ם נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהֹוִֽה׃פ
verses.transliteration: nə·ḇî·’ê yiś·rā·’êl ha·nib·bə·ʾīm ’el- yə·rū·šā·lim wə·ha·ḥō·zîm lāh ḥă·zō·wn šā·lōm wə·’ên šā·lōm nə·’um ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh
verses.literal: those prophets of Israel who prophesied to Jerusalem and saw a vision of peace for her when there was no peace declares the Lord GOD
verses.literalPt: a saber, os profetas de Israel que profetizam acerca de Jerusalém e para ela têm visões de paz, quando não há paz, diz o Senhor Jeová.

verses.original: וְאַתָּ֣ה בֶן־ אָדָ֗ם שִׂ֤ים פָּנֶ֙יךָ֙ אֶל־ בְּנ֣וֹת עַמְּךָ֔ הַמִּֽתְנַבְּא֖וֹת מִֽלִּבְּהֶ֑ן וְהִנָּבֵ֖א עֲלֵיהֶֽן׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’at·tāh ḇen- ’ā·ḏām śîm pā·ne·ḵā ’el- bə·nō·wṯ ‘am·mə·ḵā ham·miṯ·nab·bə·’ō·wṯ mil·lib·bə·hen wə·hin·nā·ḇê ‘ă·lê·hen
verses.literal: Now O son of man set your face against the daughters of your people who prophesy out of their own imagination Prophesy against them
verses.literalPt: Tu, filho do homem, volta o teu rosto contra as filhas do teu povo que profetizam do seu coração; e profetiza contra elas,

verses.original: וְאָמַרְתָּ֞ כֹּה־ אָמַ֣ר׀ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֗ה הוֹי֩ לִֽמְתַפְּר֨וֹת כְּסָת֜וֹת עַ֣ל׀ כָּל־ אַצִּילֵ֣י יָדַ֗י וְעֹשׂ֧וֹת הַמִּסְפָּח֛וֹת עַל־ רֹ֥אשׁ כָּל־ קוֹמָ֖ה לְצוֹדֵ֣ד נְפָשׁ֑וֹת הַנְּפָשׁוֹת֙ תְּצוֹדֵ֣דְנָה לְעַמִּ֔י וּנְפָשׁ֖וֹת לָכֶ֥נָה תְחַיֶּֽינָה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’ā·mar·tā kōh- ’ā·mar ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh hō·w lim·ṯap·pə·rō·wṯ kə·sā·ṯō·wṯ ‘al kāl- ’aṣ·ṣî·lê yā·ḏay wə·‘ō·śō·wṯ ham·mis·pā·ḥō·wṯ ‘al- rōš kāl- qō·w·māh lə·ṣō·w·ḏêḏ nə·p̄ā·šō·wṯ han·nə·p̄ā·šō·wṯ tə·ṣō·w·ḏê·ḏə·nāh lə·‘am·mî ū·nə·p̄ā·šō·wṯ lā·ḵe·nāh ṯə·ḥay·ye·nāh
verses.literal: and tell them that this is what the Lord GOD says Woe to the women who sew magic charms on their wrists . . . and make veils for the heads of people of every height in order to ensnare their souls Will you ensnare the souls of My people . . . but preserve your own . . .
verses.literalPt: dizendo: Assim diz o Senhor Jeová: Ai das mulheres que cosem almofadas para todos os cotovelos e fazem lenços para as cabeças de pessoas de toda estatura, a fim de caçarem almas! Acaso, caçareis as almas do meu povo, e conservareis em vida almas para vosso proveito?

verses.original: וַתְּחַלֶּלְ֨נָה אֹתִ֜י אֶל־ עַמִּ֗י בְּשַׁעֲלֵ֣י שְׂעֹרִים֮ וּבִפְת֣וֹתֵי לֶחֶם֒ לְהָמִ֤ית נְפָשׁוֹת֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹֽא־ תְמוּתֶ֔נָה וּלְחַיּ֥וֹת נְפָשׁ֖וֹת אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹא־ תִֽחְיֶ֑ינָה בְּכַ֨זֶּבְכֶ֔ם לְעַמִּ֖י שֹׁמְעֵ֥י כָזָֽב׃ס
verses.transliteration: wat·tə·ḥal·lɛl·nå̄h ’ō·ṯî ’el- ‘am·mî bə·ša·‘ă·lê śə·‘ō·rîm ū·ḇip̄·ṯō·w·ṯê le·ḥem lə·hā·mîṯ nə·p̄ā·šō·wṯ ’ă·šer lō- ṯə·mū·ṯe·nāh ū·lə·ḥay·yō·wṯ nə·p̄ā·šō·wṯ ’ă·šer lō- ṯiḥ·ye·nāh bə·ḵaz·zeḇ·ḵem lə·‘am·mî šō·mə·‘ê ḵā·zāḇ
verses.literal: You have profaned Me among My people for handfuls of barley and scraps of bread By lying to My people who would listen . . . you have killed those who should not have died and spared those who should not have lived
verses.literalPt: Profanastes-me entre o meu povo por punhados de cevada e por pedaços de pão, para fazerdes morrer as almas que não devem morrer e para conservardes em vida as almas que não devem viver, mentindo ao meu povo, que escuta mentiras.

verses.original: לָכֵ֞ן כֹּה־ אָמַ֣ר׀ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֗ה הִנְנִ֤י אֶל־ כִּסְּתוֹתֵיכֶ֙נָה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אַ֠תֵּנָה מְצֹדְד֨וֹת שָׁ֤ם אֶת־ הַנְּפָשׁוֹת֙ לְפֹ֣רְח֔וֹת וְקָרַעְתִּ֣י אֹתָ֔ם מֵעַ֖ל זְרוֹעֹֽתֵיכֶ֑ם וְשִׁלַּחְתִּי֙ אֶת־ הַנְּפָשׁ֔וֹת אֲשֶׁ֥ר אַתֶּ֛ם מְצֹדְד֥וֹת אֶת־ נְפָשִׁ֖ים לְפֹרְחֹֽת׃
verses.transliteration: lā·ḵên kōh- ’ā·mar ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh hin·nî ’el- kis·sə·ṯō·w·ṯê·ḵe·nāh ’ă·šer ’at·tê·nāh mə·ṣō·ḏə·ḏō·wṯ šām ’eṯ- han·nə·p̄ā·šō·wṯ lə·p̄ō·rə·ḥō·wṯ wə·qā·ra‘·tî ’ō·ṯām mê·‘al zə·rō·w·‘ō·ṯê·ḵem wə·šil·laḥ·tî ’eṯ- han·nə·p̄ā·šō·wṯ ’ă·šer ’at·tem mə·ṣō·ḏə·ḏō·wṯ ’eṯ- nə·p̄ā·šîm lə·p̄ō·rə·ḥōṯ
verses.literal: Therefore this is what the Lord GOD says See I am against the magic charms with which you ensnare . . . souls like birds and I will tear them from your arms So I will free the souls you have ensnared - like birds
verses.literalPt: Pelo que assim diz o Senhor Deus: Eis que eu sou contra as vossas almofadas com as quais vós ali caçais as almas como a pássaros e as arrancarei dos vossos braços; soltarei as almas, sim, as almas que vós caçais como pássaros.

verses.original: וְקָרַעְתִּ֞י אֶת־ מִסְפְּחֹֽתֵיכֶ֗ם וְהִצַּלְתִּ֤י אֶת־ עַמִּי֙ מִיֶּדְכֶ֔ן וְלֹֽא־ יִהְי֥וּ ע֛וֹד בְּיֶדְכֶ֖ן לִמְצוּדָ֑ה וִֽידַעְתֶּ֖ן כִּֽי־ אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·qā·ra‘·tî ’eṯ- mis·pə·ḥō·ṯê·ḵem wə·hiṣ·ṣal·tî ’eṯ- ‘am·mî mî·yeḏ·ḵen wə·lō- yih·yū ‘ō·wḏ bə·yeḏ·ḵen lim·ṣū·ḏāh wî·ḏa‘·ten kî- ’ă·nî Yah·weh
verses.literal: I will also tear off your veils and deliver My people from your hands so that they will no longer be prey in your hands Then you will know that I am the LORD
verses.literalPt: Também rasgarei os vossos lenços e livrarei das vossas mãos o meu povo, e não ficarão mais nas vossas mãos para serem caçados. Sabereis que eu sou Jeová.

verses.original: יַ֣עַן הַכְא֤וֹת לֵב־ צַדִּיק֙ שֶׁ֔קֶר וַאֲנִ֖י לֹ֣א הִכְאַבְתִּ֑יו וּלְחַזֵּק֙ יְדֵ֣י רָשָׁ֔ע לְבִלְתִּי־ שׁ֛וּב מִדַּרְכּ֥וֹ הָרָ֖ע לְהַחֲיֹתֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ya·‘an haḵ·’ō·wṯ lêḇ- ṣad·dîq še·qer wa·’ă·nî lō hiḵ·’aḇ·tîw ū·lə·ḥaz·zêq yə·ḏê rā·šā‘ lə·ḇil·tî- šūḇ mid·dar·kōw hā·rā‘ lə·ha·ḥă·yō·ṯōw
verses.literal: Because you have disheartened . . . the righteous with your lies even though I have caused them no grief and because you have encouraged . . . the wicked not to turn from their evil ways to save their lives
verses.literalPt: Pois com mentiras fizestes entristecer o coração do justo, a quem eu não entristeci; e fortalecestes as mãos do ímpio, para que não volte do seu mau caminho e seja conservado em vida.

verses.original: לָכֵ֗ן שָׁ֚וְא לֹ֣א תֶחֱזֶ֔ינָה וְקֶ֖סֶם לֹא־ תִקְסַ֣מְנָה ע֑וֹד וְהִצַּלְתִּ֤י אֶת־ עַמִּי֙ מִיֶּדְכֶ֔ן וִֽידַעְתֶּ֖ן כִּֽי־ אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: lā·ḵên šā·wəʾ lō ṯe·ḥĕ·ze·nāh wə·qe·sem lō- ṯiq·sam·nāh ‘ō·wḏ wə·hiṣ·ṣal·tî ’eṯ- ‘am·mî mî·yeḏ·ḵen wî·ḏa‘·ten kî- ’ă·nî Yah·weh
verses.literal: therefore you will no longer see false visions or practice divination . . . I will deliver My people from your hands Then you will know that I am the LORD
verses.literalPt: Por isso, não tornareis mais a ver a vaidade, nem adivinhar adivinhações; livrarei das vossas mãos o meu povo, e sabereis que eu sou Jeová.
